media.faq1_q: What is Media Buying and why does it matter?
media.faq1_a: Media Buying involves purchasing advertising space on digital platforms like Google, Facebook or Instagram. It ensures your ads reach the right audience at the right time, maximising ROI and visibility.

media.faq2_a: We analyse your objectives, market and competitors to propose an optimal budget, continuously adjusted based on performance measured via Google Analytics 4 and Tag Manager.
